findings.reason: with no owner named the worker must invent one, and the two available inventions break opposite halves of the done-when — reading the memo as "read" makes a tree never-read so the uncommitted cross-node edit is never caught, while treating every tree as read makes "a tree nobody is reading pays nothing" and the negative half of line 59 false.
findings.text: the slow signal "runs only for a tree that has an open change stream, or that was read in the last ten minutes", but the plan names no owner or caller that records a read: `reckon/serve.py` holds no reader-activity timestamp today (a grep for `last_read`, `_SERVED_READ`, `reader_activity` and `recently read` returns nothing), and the only read-derived state, `_SIGNATURE_MEMO` (`serve.py:1001`), is deleted for a root by `_invalidate_tree_views` (`serve.py:1655-1656`) at exactly the moment a change lands

findings.reason: a worker taking "the tree's own git directory" literally passes the docs tree, `_git_directory` returns `None`, the git source silently never fires, and the done-when clause requiring a git-index change with HEAD unchanged to fire the detector becomes unreachable.
findings.text: the detector's git identity is `_head_identity` paired with `_file_identity` of `_git_directory(repo_dir) / "index"`, but the watch holds only the mounted tree paths (`mounts.values()`, which `mounts.json` fills with `.../docs`) and §2 line 42 has the watch learn project and state root only, never a repository root; measured on the node, `_git_directory("/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-ambix/docs")` returns `None` because `docs/.git` does not exist, and only `_git_directory(tree.parent)` resolves to `/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-ambix/.git` with a readable `index`
